findingSchema.quoteRule: A verbatim quotation may appear in a finding only when that participant recorded the QUOTATION permission and the quotation is attributed to a pseudonymous participant ID. A quotation without recorded permission is a defect.
findingSchema.traceabilityRule: No finding may exist without at least one traceable, valid interview record and its coded units. Desk research, simulated dialogue and second-hand reports are never findings.

note: Empty by design: no valid interview record exists, therefore no finding may exist. Zero findings is an absence of data, not a negative result.
